source.input: virtual standard controller at navigator.getGamepads; no game state or command mutation

actions.name: left stick pans the production scene
right shoulder selects once while held
D-pad hold reaches normal simulation command
D-pad stop reaches normal simulation command
right stick cursor and X issue a movement order
left stick click queues a second cursor order
right trigger zooms the normal camera
Start pauses simulation and resumes on another press
display dialog suppresses controller camera and pause
reconnected held button cannot issue an unintended stop
